cause: Burden 206151 effect 3 had an existing Grievous CalculateAmount branch but no registered amount hook. Its native base 0 disabled the controller even for an eligible Grievous key.

Wound 240559 used native base 25 directly, while its matching 7.3.5 description explicitly divides m1 by 10. Native percent damage additionally truncates fractional percentages. The original first tick at two stacks inflicted 50 percent instead of 5 percent.
Healing cleanup existed only in Burden. After Burden removal on leaving, the still-active wound could damage a player already healed to 90 percent.
repair: Register the actual effect-3 periodic-dummy amount calculation, retaining native challenge level/affix admission.

Convert the actual wound base amount to percent with /10. Correct only this wound tick for the native whole-percent truncation, preserving incoming partial-tick scaling and subsequent native mitigation/proc/damage dispatch. Use a double intermediate to avoid the observed one-HP float under-rounding at five stacks.

At the real wound periodic callback, use its Unit owner and the existing 90-percent boundary. Veto the current default damage before removing the wound. Retain native 3-second period, five-stack cap, 60-second duration and stack growth.
